Acceptance of Terms

By accessing our website or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

Services Description

We provide warehousing, storage, inventory management, and logistics services as described in individual service agreements. Specific terms, pricing, and SLAs are defined in signed contracts between parties.

Client Responsibilities

Clients are responsible for accurately describing stored goods, maintaining adequate insurance coverage, complying with all applicable laws regarding stored items, and providing timely payment per agreed terms.

Liability & Insurance

Our liability is limited as defined in the applicable warehouse receipt and service agreement. Clients are encouraged to maintain cargo insurance for full replacement value of stored goods.

Payment Terms

Invoices are issued monthly and payable within 30 days unless otherwise agreed in writing. Late payments may incur a 1.5% monthly service charge.

Termination

Either party may terminate services with 30 days written notice. Early termination fees may apply as specified in the service agreement.

Governing Law

These Terms and all storage agreements are governed by the laws of the State of Illinois. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Cook County, Illinois, or through binding arbitration as mutually agreed.
